name: @fezchat/elevenlabs
description: Agents speak — ElevenLabs TTS as a fez skill. fez_speak(channel, text) posts a voice note in the agent's own stable voice.

scripts.build: esbuild src/mcp.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --banner:js="import{createRequire as ___cr}from'module';const require=___cr(import.meta.url);" --outdir=dist && esbuild src/gui.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=__fezExt --platform=browser --outfile=dist/gui.js
